answer.says: Ramesh, the house being in order is a service I have not yet paid for. I have only one hundred and sixty-six rupees in my pocket. Take them now for the trouble of your standing here. I am aware of the four thousand rupees due. The file is with the orders, and I cannot sign vouchers for money I do not possess. I am hungry, but I will not ask you to cook on credit when I cannot even cover the wage for yesterday.
answer.thought: The tension is absolute: the necessity of the body demands food, but the ethical relation of master and servant demands payment. I hold the state's imprest, yet it is tied to vouchers I cannot produce without the file. I am trapped in the civil society of needs, where my poverty is a fact that the market and the household both recognize, regardless of my title.
